Add aggregate strata to data

Source: R/hierarchy.R
mt_aggregate_strata.Rd

Sums deaths, exposures and populations of the bottom strata into every node of the hierarchy (all combinations of levels, groups and totals of the hierarchy variables). Cells are aggregated where all member strata observe the same age and period interval; other cells are dropped with a warning. Aggregate strata that are already in the data are kept as observed unless replace = TRUE; use mt_validate() with the hierarchy to check that they agree with the sums. Members of groups that are not levels of the data give a warning; a group without any is an error.

Usage

mt_aggregate_strata(data, hierarchy, replace = FALSE)

Arguments

data

An mt_data object with (at least) the bottom strata.

hierarchy

An mt_hierarchy().

replace

Replace aggregate strata that are already in the data.

Value

An mt_data object with all nodes as strata; the hierarchy is stored in $hierarchy.

Examples

x <- mt_example_regions(years = 2010:2014)
xa <- mt_aggregate_strata(x, mt_hierarchy(sex = "both", region = "all", quintile = "all"))
nrow(mt_strata(xa))
#> [1] 90
